dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit irregular, crenulated perimeter geometry with sharp high-contrast transitions from dark exterior boundaries to lighter grey interiors; most prominent in the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid high-intensity white punctate clusters distributed within the dark interstitial spaces, with a higher concentration localized on the anterior neck and lower flank regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most distinct macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal field form an irregular, non-equilateral pentagonal polygon elongated along the longitudinal axis of the specimen.
